scope: All changed meshes against every retained mesh plus all changed-versus-changed pairs. Unchanged-versus-unchanged pairs are outside this exhaustive pass. No dynamics, hardware, connectivity, fastening or as-built certification.

triangle_classifier_review.broad_phase: World-space AABB for complete selections, tolerance 1e-8 m
triangle_classifier_review.narrow_phase: All triangle AABB pairs followed by both triangles edge/face tests and coplanar 2D SAT; containment testing; closed edge incidence required for separation claim.
triangle_classifier_review.positive_witness: Original vertical ray sample independently checked with solid-angle winding number and exact point/triangle minimum surface distance, closed-edge topology; shared internal-ball volume is conservative, never an estimated complete intersection volume.
triangle_classifier_review.limits: Floating-point polygonal meshes; sampled witnesses do not quantify complete volume. Surface coincidence and failed witness checks remain review items. Self-intersection and manufacturing tolerances are not globally certified.
triangle_classifier_review.merged_components: 37 predecessors become 33 meshes; internal overlaps of formerly distinct plates are classified as merged design, not falsely described as a separated two-body interface.
